answer: Entry is borrowed reputation: remote attestation gathers an operator’s keys into one vertex, which may ripen one head per epoch. The kth head needs k unrelated sponsors, each signing with a quill and locking k ember until that head logs k judged epochs; backers forfeit if sponsored keys later share control. First head: one sponsor, one ember, one epoch. n heads need n(n+1)/2 outside quill signatures and 1²+…+n² ember—bribes, not clones.
